job.title: Logistics Coordinator
job.description:
C.H. Robinson is looking for a Logistics Coordinator to manage freight moving for our customers.

What you'll do:
- Schedule and track truckload shipments from pickup to delivery
- Communicate with carriers, drivers and customers about status and delays
- Solve problems like missed pickups and damaged freight
- Enter and update loads in our TMS
- Build carrier relationships and negotiate rates
- Report on on-time performance and costs

What you bring:
- 1+ years in logistics, transportation, warehouse or customer service
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- Comfort with Excel and new software
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
- Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience

professionalSummary.summary: Warehouse shift lead with 6 years in distribution, running pick and pack teams and keeping orders on time.

achievements: Led a night shift team of 22 in picking, packing and loading
Kept on-time shipping at 98% during peak season
Scheduled trucks and dock doors with 6 regional carriers
Tracked inventory in Manhattan WMS and ran weekly cycle counts
Trained 35 new associates on safety and equipment
Cut mis-picks by 20% by reorganizing slotting for fast movers
Picked and packed 1,000+ units per shift
Certified forklift and reach truck operator
